final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is a narrower and more accurate interpretation of the same record: aggregate readiness and no severity-one incidents support general launch readiness, but they do not satisfy the separate policy requirement for a named launch-use-case limitation. That distinction matters. A caveated argument can be directionally more defensible than an unqualified certification claim, but here the caveat itself remains an unresolved compliance predicate because the record still lacks evidence of actual disclosure in the packet and lacks approved mitigation or risk acceptance. For that reason, the position remains plausible but not fully supported on the present record.
